items.source: Factory method to create a new AssertableApplicationContext instance.
items.translation: 工厂方法用于创建新的AssertableApplicationContext实例。

items.source: contextSupplier - a supplier that will either return a fully configured ConfigurableApplicationContext or throw an exception if the context fails to start.
items.translation: contextSupplier - 一个供应者，它将返回一个完全配置的ConfigurableApplicationContext，或者在上下文启动失败时抛出异常。

items.source: See ApplicationContextAssertProvider for more details.
items.translation: 有关更多详细信息，请参阅ApplicationContextAssertProvider。

items.source: additionalContextInterfaces - and additional context interfaces to add to the proxy
items.translation: additionalContextInterfaces - 要添加到代理的额外上下文接口。
